title: `st.multiselect` options render below `st.popover`
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

When clicking on a `st.multiselect` widget used within a `st.popover`widget, the options are rendered below the popover (z-index).

### Reproducible Code Example

```Python
import streamlit as st

with st.popover("Popover"):
    items = st.multiselect("Multiselect", ["option_1", "option_2"])
```

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Click on Popover
2. Click on Multiselect

### Expected Behavior

Options are rendered on top of the popover.

### Current Behavior

Options are rendered below of the popover.

### Is this a regression?

- [x] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.59.2
- Python version: 3.13.4
- Operating System: MacOS 26.5.1
- Browser: Safari 26.5


### Additional Information

_No response_

### Triage summary

This is a confirmed **z-index / stacking regression**: when an `st.multiselect` (or other BaseWeb-based widget) lives inside an `st.popover`, its options dropdown renders *behind* the popover body instead of on top of it.

**Likely root cause:** PR [#15339](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15339) ("Remove `BaseWeb` for `Popover`") migrated `st.popover` away from BaseWeb to `[USER]/react`. The popover body is now portalled to `document.body` with an explicit `zIndex: theme.zIndices.popup !important` (see `frontend/lib/src/components/elements/Popover/styled-components.ts` → `StyledPopoverBody`, using `getOverlayZIndex` in `shared/Base/styled-components.ts`). Meanwhile `st.multiselect` still uses BaseWeb, and BaseWeb overlays render inside the shared "BaseWeb layer host" created in `RootStyleProvider.tsx`, which is a `position: fixed` container also pinned to `theme.zIndices.popup`.

Because both the popover body and the BaseWeb layer host resolve to the **same** `popup` z-index, stacking falls back to DOM order. The BaseWeb layer host is mounted at app startup (early), while the popover's `FloatingPortal` is appended when it opens (later), so the popover body wins the tie and paints over the multiselect dropdown. Before #15339, `st.popover` itself was a BaseWeb overlay in the same layer host, so a later-opened dropdown naturally stacked above it — hence this worked in previous versions. This should also affect other still-on-BaseWeb overlays used inside a popover (e.g. `st.date_input` / `st.time_input`), whereas already-migrated widgets like `st.selectbox` are appended after the popover and render correctly.

### Related Issues

- [#9340 — Popover is truncated when app is oembedded](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/9340): Also a popover layering/positioning bug where "positioning or z-index needs adjustment"; same z-index/stacking family.
- [#8322 — Alignment issue with help tooltips inside st.popover](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/8322): A nested overlay (tooltip) inside `st.popover` is clipped/mis-positioned — same theme of sub-overlays inside a popover not layering correctly.
- [#10239 — Dynamic popover height](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/10239): Involves a dropdown expanding inside `st.popover` and being cut off; related interaction between a popover and a widget's dropdown, though about height rather than z-index.
